title: Adaptive idempotency scope + backoff defaults with resumable streaming grace window
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Goal: ship a cross-language, opinionated defaults package for retries and idempotency that balances safety, cost, and ergonomics for both standard request/response and resumable streaming patterns. Deliverables: (1) default retry/backoff profile (fast-path for latency-sensitive calls, conservative-path for idempotent or long-running calls), (2) idempotency scoping and TTL guidance with client helpers, (3) streaming resume token + grace-window semantics and SDK helpers to transparently resume short lived interruptions, (4) mapping of server error taxonomy to retry decisions and SDK-visible telemetry/metrics. Must include language samples (Python/TypeScript/Go), migration notes for existing apps, and e2e tests with simulated infra failures.
acceptance_criteria: Default retry profile published and implemented in Python/TS/Go SDKs and feature-flagged for 2 weeks
Idempotency helper library added to each SDK that generates consistent idempotency keys, supports scope tags, and includes TTL enforcement (default 5m)
Resumable streaming helper supports automatic resume for transient network failures within a configurable grace_window (default 30s) and exposes resume tokens that can be attached to requests
Retryable error taxonomy documented and used by SDKs to classify errors as hard, soft, or circuit-breaking; server-provided hints (Retry-After / X-RW-Retry-Budget) are honored
Telemetry: retry_attempt_count, idempotency_key_seen, resume_attempt_count, retry_budget_exhausted emitted to console/trace system
Automated test suite covers jitter/backoff behavior, idempotency collision and expiration, and streaming resume failures/retries
implementation_notes: Defaults: max_attempts=4 for soft errors (4 attempts total), base_delay=120ms, max_delay=2000ms, jitter=decorrelated; aggressive profile for stubbed predictive low-cost calls: max_attempts=2, base_delay=50ms

Idempotency: introduce idempotency_scope (values: request, session, operation). Default scope = request. Default TTL=300s. SDK helper will synthesize key: sha256(namespace|scope|user_key|body_fingerprint|timestamp_bucket). Provide opt-out and raw-key pass-through.

Streaming resume: server emits resume_token and last_committed_offset; client stores transient resume_token for grace_window (default 30s). On network hiccup, client attempts resume with exponential backoff up to resume_max_attempts=3. If resume fails or expires, fall back to full restart and warn via telemetry.

Error taxonomy mapping: 1) Hard errors (do not retry): 4xx invalid request, auth failures, incompatible model version; 2) Soft retryable: 5xx transient infra, 429 (rate), 503 overload; 3) Suggested-retry-with-delay: responses with Retry-After header are retried respecting the header but counting toward retry budget; 4) Cost-aware non-retry: tokenization/validation errors that are safe but expensive if repeated - default to not retry.

Server hints: support X-RW-Retry-Budget header semantics: server may return remaining_budget (numeric) to indicate remaining attempts for a tenant for the time window. SDK will decrement a local per-request budget and stop retries when exhausted to avoid billing blowouts.

Config surface: env var overrides RW_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS, RW_RETRY_PROFILE, RW_RESUME_GRACE_WINDOW, RW_IDEMP_TTL; SDKs expose builder APIs to customize policies and attach custom classifiers for retryable errors.

Telemetry: emit structured attributes on spans: rw.retry.profile, rw.retry.attempts, rw.idemp.key, rw.resume.used. Add sample dashboards: Retry rate by endpoint, Resume success rate, Idempotency collisions per 1k requests.

Backward compatibility: default behavior should not change existing apps unless they opt into new profiles. Provide a migration guide and a compatibility mode that logs a deprecation warning when new default is applied to older clients.
rollout_plan: RFC and design review -> design signoff (1 week)
Merge SDK changes behind feature flag (FF_RETRY_V2) and publish prerelease packages to npm/pypi/gomod
Enable FF for small internal service cohort and monitor telemetry for 48-72h
Gradual ramp to 25% external traffic (2 days), 50% (3 days), then 100% after 1 week if stability and cost targets met
Publish migration docs and code samples simultaneously with stable package release
test_plan: Unit tests covering jitter distribution and backoff math across languages
Integration tests: simulated 500/429/503 responses and Retry-After behavior against local mock-server
Chaos tests for streaming: inject TCP resets, pause network for 5-25s and assert resume behavior within grace_window
Load test to validate retry budget enforcement to prevent multiplicative retries under load
Fuzz tests for idempotency collisions and TTL edge cases
risks: Aggressive retry defaults could increase cost for customers with high-volume idempotent calls — mitigated by budget enforcement and opt-out
Resuming streams incorrectly may cause dupes or ordering differences for stateful workloads; strongly document limitations and recommend idempotent server-side handlers
Server/SDK mismatch on resume_token formats may cause silent failures; include versioned resume_token format and backwards-compatible parsing
Telemetry gaps could leave ops blind during rollout - ensure extra retention and dashboarding during ramp
references: Previous tickets: ENG-32765, ENG-43102 (stream resume background)
